title: WeekendBoise sources
description: Every source: running, configured but waiting, ideas, and sites ruled out. Only displayName is required. An entry with a name is a configured source and needs its full adapter configuration. Ingest runs only status running. Per-adapter fields are documented in docs/sources.md.

doNotIngest.description: Companies and sites never to ingest, such as one that asked to be removed. Each item is matched, ignoring case, against a source's name, its displayName, or the host of its url with or without www. A matching source is skipped by every run and its last fetch is dropped from the raw file.

name.description: Unique slug, set once an entry is configured. Also the name of the per-source output file.

displayName.description: The place, organization, or site. The only required field. Unique, ignoring case.

status.description: Where the source stands. Missing means idea. Ingest runs only running. For planned sources that need the owner first: awaiting-reply (we asked for permission or a feed), needs-contact (no working email yet), declined (the owner said no; also list it in doNotIngest), blocked-by-terms (the site's terms forbid automated collection). For sources that will not run: online-only (out of scope for the in-person rule), defunct (no longer operating), out-of-scope.

reason.description: Why it was ruled out. Required when status is ruled-out.

adapter.description: The adapter that reads it. other is for ideas that need a new adapter; a configured entry can't use it.

url.description: Site, feed, or API endpoint. Required from feed-found on.

type.description: Auctions and Estate Sales sources: what the company is.

contact.description: How to reach the owner about permission or a feed: email, phone, or contact form.

outreach.description: Where a request to the owner stands, for a source whose status is running.

lastChecked.description: Date the entry's status was last confirmed.

optOut.description: What to do if the company asks to be removed. Adding the company to the top-level doNotIngest list stops it in one edit.

category.description: Category for this source's events. With inferCategory, the fallback.
category.$comment: Must match the ids in data/schema/categories.json.

local.description: Runs only from a home connection, because the site turns away or times out on GitHub's servers. The nightly ingest skips it and keeps its last fetch; Invoke-LocalIngest.ps1 runs it, and the Sunday ingest emails a reminder.

inferCategory.description: Choose each event's category from its tags. For sources that mix many kinds of event.

city.description: Fallback for events that do not report a city.

venue.description: Fallback for events that do not report a venue.

robotsChecked.description: Date robots.txt was read. The outcome goes in notes, or in reason if it ruled the site out.

termsChecked.description: Date the site's terms of use were read. The outcome goes in notes, or in reason if it ruled the site out.

priority.description: Whose url wins when sources report the same event. Lower is better.

fixedVenue.description: tribe, scrape, ics, rss: use the entry's venue for every event, ignoring what the event reports.

venuePrefix.description: rss: put in front of each item's ev:location to make the venue name, so "Arena" becomes "Ford Idaho Center Arena".

scrapeMode.description: scrape: jsonld reads schema.org data, cards reads HTML blocks, calendarapp reads the event JSON that City of Boise calendar pages embed in #calendar-app, civicplus reads a CivicPlus city calendar (Calendar.aspx) one month per page, chambermaster reads a ChamberMaster or GrowthZone chamber calendar one month per page and each event's iCal file, sveltekit reads the ChamberMaster calendar a SvelteKit chamber site (staridahochamber.com) embeds as page data.

salesMode.description: sales: ics reads an Events Calendar iCal export (Downs Auction), corbett reads the upcoming auctions on corbettauctions.com's home page, onthewater reads the UPCOMING SALES lines on onthewaterestatesales.com. Every mode keeps only in-person events in covered cities, and stores only title, company, city, times, and link. See adapters/sales.ps1.

eventLinkPattern.description: scrape, jsonld: regex for event links on the list page. Each linked page is read. Without it, the list page itself is read.

itemPattern.description: scrape, cards: regex matching one event's HTML block.

datePattern.description: scrape, cards: regex with named groups month and day, matched inside a card. Month is a name unless the regex also has a year group, in which case month is a number and no year is guessed. Defaults to Boise Centre markup (class="month" and class="day").

titlePattern.description: scrape, cards: regex with a named group title, matched inside a card. Defaults to the first heading.

timePattern.description: scrape, cards: regex with named groups start and optional end, such as 3:00 pm. Without it, or without a match, events are all-day.

titlePrefix.description: scrape, cards: text put in front of each title that does not already contain it, such as "Recycled Minds: ", for a company whose show titles leave out its name.

maxPages.description: scrape: most event pages to read in one run. Defaults to 40. With scrapeMode civicplus or chambermaster, how many months to read, starting with this one. Defaults to 3.

yearFromTitle.description: scrape cards: a year in the card title ("Winter Carnival 2027") sets the year of its dates instead of guessing it.

localTimeAsUtc.description: scrape, tribe, and ics: the site writes local time as UTC, as Modern Events Calendar and Events Calendar sites set to UTC+0 do. Corrects it.

locationFilter.description: ics: regex. Only events whose LOCATION matches are kept.

latlong.description: ticketmaster, seatgeek: center of an area search, as lat,lon.

radius.description: ticketmaster, seatgeek: area search radius in miles.

excludeVenueIds.description: ticketmaster: venues another source already covers.

excludeSegments.description: ticketmaster: segments another source already covers.

excludeTitlePattern.description: ticketmaster, rss, ics, tribe, meetup, eventastic, googlecalendar, and scrape with scrapeMode jsonld, cards, civicplus, or chambermaster: regex. Matching titles are skipped.

excludeDescriptionPattern.description: scrape, jsonld: regex, matched against the description as plain text with WordPress shortcodes removed. Matching events are skipped.

keepRealEstate.description: sales: keep real estate auctions, which are dropped by default. For a company whose real estate auctions are live and held at the property.

calendarId.description: googlecalendar: the public calendar's id, such as name@gmail.com or ...@group.calendar.google.com.

excludeTitles.description: googlecalendar: titles to skip, matched from the start of the title and ignoring case, on top of the adapter's defaults (Library Closed, council, zoning, school board, and library board meetings).

venueAliases.description: googlecalendar: location text (its whole text or any comma-separated part, ignoring case) to the canonical venue name. Naming the entry's venue keeps its venueKey.
